tools.name: project_contract
tools.description: Return the exact supported Connector and shared Dashboard Tool Link contract. executor.connector MUST reference connectors[].id, never a connector type. Dashboard reads and writes use window.omni.tools.call with the same toolkit.json tools as Xiaowan. Supported types: sqlite (insert/query/update/delete), xiaowan (invoke), and public HTTPS http_json (get). Call once when uncertain; do not search source code or guess names.

tools.name: project_check
tools.description: Verify a completed project before publishing. Dashboard reads and writes must use window.omni.tools.call with a local tool declared in toolkit.json; direct window.omni.db calls are rejected. toolkit.json rule: executor.connector references connectors[].id, not a type. Supported types/actions: sqlite insert/query/update/delete; xiaowan invoke; http_json get. If uncertain, call project_contract once instead of guessing or searching source code. This is structural validation only: it does not run business actions, click the App, or verify persistence. The builder must execute acceptance tests and repair failures before claiming completion.

path.description: Workspace-relative, /workspace, or omnibot workspace directory containing the completed project.

description.description: One-sentence explanation of the project's function.

entry_path.description: Required standalone HTML app entry relative to the project directory.

icon_path.description: Required SVG app icon relative to the project directory. Create it as SVG source; never use an image-generation model or raster source asset.

schema_path.description: Optional SQLite schema relative to the project directory when the database connector is used.

skill_path.description: Xiaowan SKILL.md relative to the project directory.

toolkit_path.description: Agent-callable business toolkit definition relative to the project directory.

tools.name: project_publish
tools.description: Publish or update a checked project as an enabled plugin. Dashboard and Xiaowan must share the toolkit.json Tool Link through window.omni.tools.call; publication re-runs this check. toolkit.json rule: executor.connector references connectors[].id, not a type. Supported types/actions: sqlite insert/query/update/delete; xiaowan invoke; http_json get. Re-publishing preserves connector-owned data. Publishing installs a candidate for runtime testing, not a passed acceptance result. Continue with real write/read, UI and lifecycle tests using available capabilities; fix failures yourself and report blocked tests honestly.
